articles.title: Zcash developers plan a fix to keep ZEC swaps private from future quantum computers
articles.snippet: The team behind Zakura wants every swap through NEAR Intents to get its own key, so a refund address left on NEAR’s public chain can’t expose a user’s wider payment history.

articles.title: Market participants weigh in on SEC’s proposed crypto regulations
articles.snippet: The financial agency is scheduled to close public comments on its ‘Regulation Crypto Assets’ proposed in August.

articles.title: Public companies object to OKX-ICE’s tokenized stock plan
articles.snippet: Nine public companies objected to having their shares offered in tokenized form by OKX and ICE, testing whether platforms can create blockchain-based markets without issuer consent.

articles.title: Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds
articles.snippet: Qubic says 87.1% of the stolen funds remain onchain and the rest were frozen at crypto exchange MEXC, as network validators prepare to vote on a recovery plan.

articles.title: Anthropic Gives 5% of Itself to the Public. Musk Answers by Giving Away SpaceX Shares
articles.snippet: Anthropic committed 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund, and within hours Elon Musk promised a SpaceX share to every American child.
